trials.reasoning: Two buyers describe and thank the vendor for a lifetime deal. The 1-star report that it did not work on one Mac concerns functionality, not whether lifetime access was offered.

exhibits.quote: This tool never worked on my mac inspite of giving all the permissions it needs.
exhibits.argument: Lifetime access is undermined if the tool never worked at all for the buyer.

exhibits.quote: Well worth the price! Thanks for the lifetime deal, Garrett Grimm.
exhibits.argument: Buyer thanks vendor for the lifetime deal, confirming lifetime access was offered.

exhibits.quote: It keeps my browser clean and saves me from forgetting important pages. Great value for a lifetime deal.
exhibits.argument: Buyer describes purchase as a lifetime deal, confirming lifetime access claim.
